messages:
olivia: Heads-up — Pulsar Labs onboarding completed a few mins ago but their API requests are getting 403 `insufficient_scope`. Console shows the key is Active but roles: `read_only`. They expected write/generate scopes. Anyone seen provisioning hand out read-only by default?
sam: Can you paste tenant id + sample request/response? Also which onboarding flow (console vs OIDC)?
olivia: Tenant `pulsar-8d2`. They used Console -> Project -> Keys -> Create API key. Sample curl and response:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-pulsar-XXXX' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"test"}'
```
Response: `403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","required":"model:generate"}`
maya: Looking at onboarder logs now. I see job `onboard-2024-11-12-768` called IAM grant with role `read_only` — it fell back because project metadata was missing `allow_write` flag at the time of key creation. Investigating why metadata write lagged.
sam: Got it. Sometimes projects created from the Trial template restrict scopes. @olivia can you confirm the UI flow they used (did they pick a 'trial' template)? Also double-check whether the key is a `service_key` vs `api_key` — defaults differ.
olivia: They clicked "Create API key" from Project settings -> Keys (no explicit service key toggle). UI showed "Key created" toast and copied value. Customer says no extra toggles.
infra-bot: Deploy note: `2024.11.12-iam-fix` rolled out that changes default role mapping: if `project.type == 'sandbox'` grant `read_only`. There's an open rollback toggle but this looks like a race with metadata setting.
alex: Quick workaround for support: you can update scopes via CLI or console. Example CLI edit:
```
rwctl iam update-key --key sk-pulsar-XXXX --scopes model:generate,project:write
```
Or Admins can edit scopes: Project -> Keys -> Edit (scopes).
maya: Root cause appears to be a provisioning race: project creation path sometimes doesn't persist `allow_write` before the create-key flow completes, so create-key uses a safe fallback `read_only`. I'll add a guard to block key creation until metadata is present. I'll escalate to eng-runtime. For immediate fix I can reprovision a key with correct scopes for Pulsar. @olivia want me to do that now?
olivia: Yes please re-provision and paste new key in the support ticket (do not post in channel). Also add brief RCA note for the customer. Thanks. :pray:
alex: Pinging #eng-runtime with job id `onboard-2024-11-12-768` and logs (link attached in ticket).
sam: :thumbsup:
maya: Repro steps I will include in the ticket: 1) create project via API without `allow_write` flag 2) immediately call create-key endpoint 3) observe key gets `read_only` fallback. Patch ETA: 3 hours for guard + hotfix to backfill keys created in last 2 hours.
olivia: Great — I'll update Pulsar support ticket and mark as high priority until hotfix is out.
